snippet.title: Demon Stick - Official Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
A difficult game about you being a demon, trapped in a stick. Inspired by foddian games like Getting Over it and Baby Steps. Made from original Hieronymus Bosch artwork cutouts. 

Available on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4108540/Demon_Stick/
